subject: Decision ladder: hosting option criteria & MAP close timeline
messages:
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@brightleaf.health>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ravi Sen <r.sen@brightleaf.health>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Decision ladder: hosting option criteria & MAP close timeline

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. BrightLeaf's legal and infra teams have reviewed the high-level options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and want to see a concise mutual action plan that maps evaluation criteria to a closing timeline. Key items they care about:

- Data residency and VPC connectivity for PHI.
- SOC 2 + encryption / KMS integration and evidence.
- Unit economics at 95% P95 latency and steady-state throughput (dedicated).
- Migration plan from PoC to Production.

Can you send a draft MAP that: (a) lists decision criteria per hosting option, (b) a 6–8 week evaluation timeline with key milestones and owners, and (c) suggested gating metrics for go/no-go?

Attachments: BrightLeaf_RFI_notes.pdf (our internal questionnaire)

We'd like to align on the plan by end of week so procurement can lock the Q1 budget. Proposed next touch: Thu 24th, 10am PT for 30m to review the MAP.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Liu
Head of Engineering Programs
BrightLeaf Health

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@brightleaf.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Decision ladder: hosting option criteria & MAP close timeline

Hi Dana —

Appreciate the clear asks. I've attached a first-pass MAP and an evaluation "decision ladder" that ties specific criteria to hosting choices (see MAP_draft_BrightLeaf_v1.xlsx). High level:

- PoC (2–4 weeks): Hosted API with VPC peering + strict prefix caching. Fastest route to start running representative workload.
- Pilot (4–6 weeks): Dedicated capacity with reserved GPU pool if you need predictable p95 and throughput guarantees. We include a canary region and quantized model variant for cost testing.
- Production (6–12 weeks from PoC): Private deployment (customer VPC / on-prem) if PHI governance requires it — includes KMS/HSM integration and audit log forwarding.

Proposed gating metrics (examples in the MAP):
- Latency: P95 <= 300ms for 512-token median sequences on dedicated during pilot load tests.
- Cost: token unit cost delta compared to hosted baseline <= 30% after batching and KV cache tuning.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II evidence + KMS proof-of-concept for the private option.

I've flagged two items we need from your side to hit the timeline:
- Access to a representative prompt set and sample traffic (anonymized).
- SOC 2 questionnaire answers (you already attached the RFI — thanks).

I'll own the MAP doc and timeline; Marissa will lead commercial/contracting details; Karthik will coordinate on deployment SOWs and capacity planning.

Attachments: MAP_draft_BrightLeaf_v1.xlsx (draft mutual action plan, evaluation matrix and milestone dates)

Available for Thu 24th 10am PT — adding a calendar invite now.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@brightleaf.health>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Decision ladder: hosting option criteria & MAP close timeline

Dana / team —

Thanks Mateo — this looks good. To set expectations from the commercial side:

- Hosted PoC: small usage credit for the first 30 days, no long-term commitment.
- Dedicated pilot: month-to-month reserved capacity with a recommended minimum 3-month commit for predictable pricing; we'll provide a pricing sheet tied to the MAP milestones.
- Private: enterprise license + deployment fee and a 12-month minimum for support/patching in on-prem or VPC-hosted models.

Procurement note: if BrightLeaf needs a security addendum (SLA / DPA / BAA), have legal send an annotated version. We can turn around redlines in 3 business days for standard clauses.

Karthik — can you prepare a high-level SOW template for the dedicated/pvt options and a sketch of the capacity profile we'll need for their projected 50–100 QPS peak?

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@brightleaf.health>

Cc: Ravi Sen <r.sen@brightleaf.health>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Decision ladder: hosting option criteria & MAP close timeline

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few quick confirmations and next steps:

- Thu 24th 10am PT confirmed for the MAP walkthrough. Ravi (infra) will join to talk VPC and KMS.
- We'll share a sanitized prompt set and a redacted traffic sample by EOD Thu (for you to start baseline tests).
- Legal will send a DPA/BAA template to Marissa for redlines — expect that Thu afternoon.
- If the pilot shows p95 < 350ms and cost targets align, procurement will target a decision window the week of Jan 19th. That's our internal goal for production selection.

Please send the DocuSign link when the MAP is ready so our procurement can track milestones.

Onwards —
Dana
